build_language_names_dict: build a dictionary mapping language names to their corresponding language codes from a list and names dict
lookup_LANGUAGE_NAMES: look up language names, short codes, and script codes for a given LASER language code
list_LASER3_LANGUAGES: list all language codes supported by the LASER 3 multilingual sentence embedding model
list_LASER2_LANGUAGES: list all language codes supported by the LASER 2 multilingual sentence embedding model
list_SPM_LANGUAGE: list all SentencePiece model language codes used for LASER tokenization
